about.title: About me
about.body: I'm 21 years old. I'm studying for a Bachelor's degree in Performing Arts and a Public Translation degree at UADE (Buenos Aires City). I take classes in contemporary dance, jazz, and urban dance, and I'm at an intermediate-advanced level in acrobatics.
